mapper.select: SELECT PBANC_SN AS pbancSn, PBANC_NM AS pbancNm, TO_CHAR(BID_DDLN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS ddlnText FROM TB_BID_PBANC WHERE BID_DDLN_DT IS NOT NULL AND PBANC_STTS_CD IN ('PS030', 'PS040') AND TRUNC(BID_DDLN_DT) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) = #{daysLeft} ORDER BY PBANC_SN

SELECT N.NOTI_SN AS notiSn, U.EML_ADDR AS emlAddr, N.NOTI_CN AS content FROM TB_NOTI N JOIN TB_USER U ON U.USER_ID = N.RCVR_ID WHERE N.NOTI_TYPE_CD = #{typeCd} AND N.NOTI_CN LIKE #{tag} || '%' AND N.EML_SNDNG_YN = 'N' AND N.CRT_DT >= SYSDATE - 2 AND U.EML_ADDR IS NOT NULL AND U.ACNT_STTS_CD <> 'AS050' ORDER BY N.NOTI_SN
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_NOTI SET EML_SNDNG_YN = 'Y' WHERE NOTI_SN = #{notiSn}
